pyCTF

Capture the Flag & Coin Race

A two-player platform game of jumps, dashes, and quick decisions. Take turns attacking and defending in Capture the Flag, or race to collect the coin. Play against a friend or the NPC.

Updates & patches

From pygame to Rust

Music by John Brennan and Nicolas (me), Coin spritesheet from La Red Games on itch.io

This is a more polished Rust port of my original pyCTF project, built with Python and pygame as part of a DCU / CTYI project. It builds on the original platforming and capture-the-flag gameplay with refined movement, new game modes, and a browser-ready experience.

View the original pyCTF project on GitHub ↗

P1 A / D move · W jump · S drop · Q / E dash

P2 J / L move · I jump · K drop · U / O dash
